tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shing phag zla tshes la yab rje dam pa'i mchod thang rgyab gzungs 'bri tho// oṃ swasti/ rten thams cad kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma brgyud pa la rim pa bzhin/ oṃ āḥbadzra rdo rje 'chang dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra naṃ bdag med ma ratma hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbirwa pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ nag po pa kahṇa pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥḍā ma ru pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a wa ddhu ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥg ya dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ'abrog mi shākya dzñā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ se ston sarba pā shya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥchos 'bar dharma dzwa la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs chen a nanda garbha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrtse mo paṇye gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgrags pa kirti dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a nanda sa paṇa dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ'aphags pa ma ti dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbazang po dpal bha drwa shrī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbla chen rgyal kun dga' mtshan dpal ā nanda dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a nanda a nanda maṅga la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnam mkha' rgyal mtshan ga ga dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan pradzñā dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs lo a nanda puṇya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsngags 'chang chen po a nanda ratna hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbasod nams dbang po puṇyant+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgrags pa blo gros kirti ma ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ'ajam dbyangs kun bsod mañdzu gho ṣā banda puṇya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbasod nams dbang phyug puṇya shwa ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥzhang dkon mchog dpal ratna shrī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbrag phug pa puṇya shrī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ chos rje bla ma puṇya dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdapal ldan tshul khrims shrī wabda shī la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbuddhā shrī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥngor chen rdo rje 'chang badzra dha ra nanda bha drwa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdakon mchog rgyal mtshan ratna dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkun dga' dbang phyug a nande shwa ra hūm̐/

oṃ āḥbasod nams seng ge puṇya singha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdakon mchog 'phel ratna wardhā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsangs rgyas rin chen buddhā ratna hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdakon mchog lhun grub ratna ni ra bho ga hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdakon mchog rgyal mtshan ratna sa mu tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsangs rgyas rgyal mtshan tsakra sambha ra buddha dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ dhe wa pi tsu kyai rdo rje badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bde mchog oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥgasang 'dus badzra dhrika hūm̐/ oṃ rdo rje bzhon nu badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bi ghnan bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ru lu ru lu yang dag hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ tadya thā/ tshe lha a pa ra mi ta a yur dzñā na hrīḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ sarba bita sarba rnam snang a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ 'jam dbyangs āḥr pa tsa na dhiḥ oṃ āḥthub dbang shākya mu ne hūm̐/ sangs rgyas rjes su spyod pa la na mo/ 'di nas sangs rgyas rnams ma rdzogs par rim par btags/ sangs rgyas mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po la na mo/ sangs rgyas 'khon dang rgyal dang rnam par gnon pa la na mo/ sangs rgyas rin chen gzugs bkod 'od snang la na mo/ sangs rgyas bdud dang yid gnyis kun 'joms rnam par gnon pa la na mo/ sangs rgyas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo 'byung ba'i dpal la na mo/ sangs rgyas rin chen gdugs 'phags snang la na mo/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba la na mo/ sangs rgyas skrag med mun bral ting 'dzin mngon 'phags rgyal po la na mo/ sangs rgyas dang po sems bskyed the tshom gcod mdzad la na mo/ oṃ āḥnye sras byams pa mai tri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs snying kṣi ti gharbha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥphyag rdor badzra pa ṇi hūm̐/

oṃ āḥnam snying kha garbha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥspyan gzigs lo ki shwa ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ'ajam dbyangs mañdzu shrī hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ṇi wi ra sgrib sil ṇa bi gaṃ bhi ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs manta bha dra kun bzang hūm̐/ rang rgyal bcu gnyis yod na/ gdung ba gsal ba drug las med la na mo/ snang ba brtsegs pa la na mo/ 'jigs pa med pa la na mo/ dpal bo 'dul ba la na mo/ shes rab mgyogs can la na mo/ ri bo rgyal la na mo/ smra ba'i sgra can la na mo/ bse ru lta bu la na mo/ dug chen 'joms la na mo/ rdzu 'phrul cher ston la na mo/ seng ge sgra la na mo/ yid las myur la na mo/ bcu gnyis las med na 'di nas ji ltar rigs pa bris/ yan lag 'byung ba la na mo/ ma pham pa la na mo/ nags la gnas la na mo/ dus ldan la na mo/ rdo rje mo'i bu la na mo/ bzang po la na mo/ gser be'u la na mo/ bha ra dhwa gser can la na mo/ ba ku la la na mo/ sgra gcan 'dzin la na mo/ lam phran brtan la na mo/ bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len la na mo/ lam brtan la na mo/ klu'i sde la na mo/ sbed byed pa la na mo/ mi phyed pa la na mo/ hūm̐ 'byung 'dul badzra phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la gur mgon hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e ka yum chen dza ṭī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka lī 'dod khams ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gnod sbyin yab kā la yakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā li yakṣi ṇi yum hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra yakṣa pu tra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ru tra bha drwa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ru lu rakṣa si sring mo hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ zhal tsaturmu ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sha ma shwa na nor skyong zung pa ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shanta padma dkar mo kurtiṃ bhyoḥ oṃ sarba mā ra kriṣṇa bdud rgyal ka pā la ma la dhā ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shrā wā ṇa ye rnam sras swā hā/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len ser po dra ye swāhā/

oṃ ind+ra dzaṃ nag ni bhu mu kham bhra ma ri swāhā/ oṃ a na le dbyu gu ma gung ma ma hā grihṇa paṇḍi ye swāhā/ oṃ grihṇa ma ha g.yas pī sha tsi na ye swāhā/ oṃ shu tra mu ṣe ma hā g.yon pī sha tsi na ye swāhā/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ye de hi ḍā ki ni dzwa la srog sgrub sambha raṃ swāhā/ dbus bzhugs khang steng ma'i bla ma la/ oṃ āḥbadzra dha ra a nanda maṅga la hūm̐/ rten gtso bo'i dbu'i dpral du/ oṃ sarba bi dyā swāhā/ mgrin par oṃ/ badzra a yu ṣe swāhā/ thugs kar/ oṃ āḥn ma shrī bhū mi paṇḍu ma hā mant+ra dhā ra gu ru sarba dzñā wa gand+rā nanda puṇya ratna maṅga la kirti dhwa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tunte ṣaṇa ta thā ga to hya wa datte ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha a waṃ ba dī ma hā shrā ma ṇa/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbhu khaṃ badzi bha wa dṛ dha tiṣṭha bhu khaṃ swāhā/ rten gtso bo'i pad gdan nas gzhal yas khang dang ri rab kyi dbyibs dang bstun pa'i dge ba 'di yis sogs dpe bzhin gyi rjes su/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ /ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /bdag kyang skye ba 'di nas bzung nas su/ /ji srid rdo rje 'dzin pa ma thob bar/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gzhung dang mi 'bral zhing / /bla ma'i tshogs kyi bran du skye bar shog /bla ma'i tshogs rnams mnyes par byas nas kyang / /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan mngon gyur nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /dri med sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la/

/skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye zhing / /ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi yi grur zhugs te/ /shin tu brgal dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /bde chen thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gcong rong nang zhugs nas/ /skye ba'i chu bo ldog par dka' mod kyi/ /las kyi dbang gis dmyal ba myong na yang / /dam pa khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis so/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub sems bskyed sogs/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis dge ba ci bsags pa/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i shes rab kyis/ /yod med la sogs dmigs pas dug spangs nas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das la mi smon pa'i/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur thob shog /byang phyogs skyong ba'i skyob pa mchog gyur pa/ /mkhas grub rgya mtshos yongs su gang ba'i gnas/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir bstan pa gsal mdzad pa'i/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje paṇḍi ta/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog/ //ces bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod thang 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros mched kyis bzhengs pa dge legs 'phel// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ shing phag zla tshes la yab rje dam pa'i mchod thang rgyab gzungs 'bri tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
